sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:52

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:52:1
items.html: The NHY of AVI are Mochin for ZA, and the NHY of YESHSUT are Mochin and enter into the Reisha [head] of the Nukva: The meaning is not that the NHY of the upper AVI of Atzilut become Mochin for ZA, for that is entirely impossible, since no Partzuf receives Mochin except from its own Upper One, and not from the Upper One of its Upper One. And the Upper One of ZA is YESHSUT, and not AVI, who are the Upper One of his Upper One. Rather, the meaning is that AVI together with YESHSUT become one Partzuf, as was the case here with the AVI of Nekudim. And then the NHY of YESHSUT that are clothed in it are regarded as the Mochin, which are the discernment of the NHY of AVI, since YESHSUT then becomes the actual body of AVI. And therefore his HGT are regarded as receiving from the discernment of their Gufim, similar to the reception by the HGT of Nekudim of the Gufim of AVI. And this is by virtue of ZA clothing in the posterior of AVI that fell into their place, as the ARI says. But the Nukva of ZA cannot receive as he does, since the Nukva has no root in HGT, and her whole self begins from the Chazeh of ZA downward, that is, only NHY; and even this came to her by force of her inclusion in ZA, for from her root she is only the discernment of Hod alone, as is known. Rather, the utmost of her Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] is that she receive similarly to the reception by the NHY of Nekudim of the discernment of the Gufim of YESHSUT, which is the utmost height of a Partzuf of NHY. And then they are the two great lights, which do not need one another. For the Nukva receives a Partzuf of NHY from the discernment of the Guf of YESHSUT, similar to the NHY of Nekudim; and ZA receives his Partzuf of HGT from the discernment of the Guf of the upper AVI who are joined with YESHSUT, similar to the HGT of Nekudim. And just as the HGT of Nekudim and the NHY of Nekudim did not need one another, so too ZA and the Nukva will not need one another. And therefore ZA no longer governs the Nukva and is not regarded as greater than she, since she does not need him. Understand this.
